data.title: ACEFAST A119 45W GaN USB-C Fast Charger Set + 1.2m Cable
data.descriptionHtml:
ACEFAST A119 is a compact 45W GaN USB-C fast charger set with an EU plug and an included 1.2m USB-C to USB-C cable. Designed for fast, efficient charging of compatible smartphones, tablets, laptops and other USB-C devices.

Key Features

  • 45W USB-C fast charging with Power Delivery support.
  • GaN technology for higher efficiency, lower heat and a compact body.
  • PPS support for dynamic voltage adjustment on compatible devices.
  • Supports major fast-charge protocols including PD3.0, PD2.0, QC4+, QC3.0, QC2.0, AFC, FCP and SCP.
  • Single USB-C port with up to 45W output.
  • EU plug and universal 100–240V input for convenient everyday and travel use.
  • Includes a 1.2m USB-C to USB-C fast charging cable.
  • Flame-retardant PC housing with multiple safety protections.

Specifications

  • Brand: ACEFAST
  • Model: A119
  • Charger type: GaN wall charger
  • Maximum output: 45W
  • Port: 1 × USB-C
  • Input: AC 100–240V, 1.2A, 50/60Hz
  • USB-C PPS output: 5–21V ⎓ 2.1A
  • USB-C fixed outputs: 5V ⎓ 3A, 9V ⎓ 3A, 12V ⎓ 3A, 15V ⎓ 3A, 20V ⎓ 2.25A
  • Fast-charge protocols: PPS / PD3.0 / PD2.0 / QC4+ / QC3.0 / QC2.0 / AFC / FCP / SCP
  • Material: Flame-retardant PC
  • Dimensions: 76.5 × 33.5 × 33.5 mm
  • Charger weight: 85 g
  • Plug: EU
  • Cable: USB-C to USB-C, 1.2 m
  • Certifications: CE, RoHS, EAC, ERP6
  • Color: Black

What's in the Box

  • ACEFAST A119 45W GaN USB-C wall charger
  • 1.2m USB-C to USB-C fast charging cable

Compatibility: Suitable for compatible USB-C laptops, smartphones, tablets and other devices that support USB-C charging. Actual charging speed depends on the connected device and charging protocol.
